rules.condition: multi-bit request and response bundles crossing the domains
rules.statement: The multi-bit request and response bundles must never be sampled by a synchronizer; only one-bit control signals pass through synchronizers.
The source must hold the multi-bit request and response bundles stable for the whole handshake.

rules.condition: after the control bit has arrived in the destination domain
rules.statement: The destination must load the multi-bit bundle only after the associated control bit has arrived.
The timing of the bundle paths must be bounded by set_max_delay constraints (Section 17).
The bridge must always support APB4 write and read transfers across two asynchronous clocks (FEAT-001, REQ-FUNC-001 to REQ-FUNC-009).
The bridge must always transport wait states and error responses across the crossing (FEAT-002).
The bridge must provide the two-phase handshake when PARA_APBCDC_HS_TYPE is 0 (FEAT-003).
The bridge must provide the four-phase handshake when PARA_APBCDC_HS_TYPE is 1 (FEAT-004).
The bridge must support selectable synchronizer depth with PARA_APBCDC_CELL_TYPE 1 to 4; 0 is for simulation only (FEAT-005).
The bridge must provide APB5 wake-up signaling when PARA_APBCDC_APB5 is 1 (FEAT-006).

rules.condition: PARA_APBCDC_APB5 = 1 and user signal width above 0
rules.statement: The bridge must provide the APB5 user signals when PARA_APBCDC_APB5 is 1 and the width is above 0 (FEAT-007).
The IP must always deliver an executable SDC with the crossing constraints (FEAT-008).
